answer: Each identity must post a 25 POA bond on two independent chains and link them through a cross-chain registry, verified by light-client proofs before any payout. A duplicate identity on any chain slashes all its bonds, so a haven for fakes cannot hide across ledgers. Each extra fake must fund fresh bonds on every chain, so 100 fakes cost 100 times the honest bond plus relay fees, and the registry kernel checks each link like cargo at a wharf, rejecting any serial already claimed.
